scope: Responsive typography and shared menu across Home, About Me, Scouting, Impact & Leadership, Inside the Cells and World

source.note: Original SVG dimensions and existing Figma positions retained; no fonts or artwork replaced

changes.insideText: SVG text fills its Figma box using width:100% rather than a transform requiring length/length division
changes.menu: SVG widths use original art widths scaled once to the header canvas; chevron keeps its source ratio
changes.scouting: Text, flower overlays and arrows use source SVG widths and ordinary length/numeric arithmetic; nested scale transforms removed
changes.dropdown: Null-relatedTarget blur on Safari no longer removes a hovered dropdown before link click; touch pointer entry does not open via mouse hover before tap toggles

verification.specialDisplays: Portrait, ultrawide, 4K, short 600px-high desktop, split view, both sides of changed layout boundaries and original 1440x1168 frame
verification.layout: No horizontal overflow; SVG text matches boxes, all measured overview captions clear titles, menu stays inside links with source aspect ratio
verification.reproduction: legacy-transform-before-after.json: original CSS with rejected transforms reproduced overlap at 1280x800/DPR2; gaps -17.19/-21.77px become +8.72/+3.81px
verification.interactions: Shared header DOM, dropdown click and touch, Enter/Escape, focus exit, Back/Forward, startup reload/direct URL reset and reduced motion passed
verification.hmr: hmr.json: CSS reload preserved header and navigation
verification.runtime: No application console errors/warnings, page errors or failed HTTP responses observed. Expected Framer Motion reduced-motion development notices recorded separately
verification.rerun: node scripts/check-responsive-type.mjs <Playwright-module-URL> chromium|webkit; set QA_LABEL to distinguish engine versions

limitations.hardware: Windows-hosted Playwright browsers and Retina/viewport emulation; not a physical MacBook test
limitations.oldSafari: The Playwright WebKit 18.4 build accepts typed division. Rejection is explicitly simulated, not claimed as an observed rejection by this build
limitations.liveDesign: Connected Figma Bridge currently targets Ngo Bao Chau; this patch uses the repository's recorded Linh Anh geometry and original SVG assets
limitations.graph: Native Codegraph MCP CLI architecture/search/reindex succeeded. Parser reports partial coverage for CSS @container rules; those rules were inspected directly and verified in browsers
